calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Aug-25-2015 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change and Gender Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Charles Crompton, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840.
Petitioner Francisco Centenor Uribe, aka Francisco Centeno, aka Leslie Centeno Uribe, aka Leslie Centeno, aka Leslie Uribe, aka Leslie Charon, present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined through Spanish Interpreter Chichi Archibold.
Declaration of Sworn Physician on file.

No objections to the proposed change of name and gender were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations of the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Name Change to Leslie Centeno Uribe and Gender from male to female.
Decree changing Name and Gender signed by the court.
